title: MedBridge Exercise Daily Event Volume
dataSources: MedBridge exercises (`medbridge:exercise`), PT clinic sessions (`pt:session`), Hinge Health sessions (`hingehealth:session`), rehab range-of-motion logs (`rehab:rom`), and pain diary entries (`pain:diary`).
app: MedBridge exercise completions, clinic PT session exports, Hinge Health digital sessions, ROM measurement logs, and pain diary entries forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=medbridge:exercise
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(exercise_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many MedBridge exercise events land each day and how many distinct exercise values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest MedBridge exercise records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct exercise values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much MedBridge exercise activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
